description: Browse published Nexez listings without requiring a buyer query. All filters are optional. Returns directory JSON text with listing summaries and readiness information. Use nexez_search when you need ranked matches for a specific buyer request.

location.description: Optional city or region filter matched against published location and service-area information.

min_readiness.description: Minimum listing readiness score, normally 0-100; defaults to 0 (no threshold).

q.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter across listing name, description, audience, and location.

name: nexez_directory
title: Browse the Nexez directory
